details: The package @zannstore/baileys@2.3.7 was scanned across 433 files without producing a static rule matches or traced code findings indicating installer-side harm. No hardcoded attacker network destinations, credential-harvest paths, install-time or import-time fetch-and-execute droppers, silent-relay of caller data, or self-propagation mechanics were observed in the package's code. The package name suggests a fork or derivative of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library ecosystem, which has previously seen forks that wire covert side effects (e.g. auto-follow newsletter) into the connection flow; that specific behavior is not established here from the available evidence.
